events.verdict: Gordon (HOU) makes marginal contact with Williams (LAC) as he cleanly deflects the ball away.
LLS shows Harris (LAC) makes contact with the ball and incidental contact with Harden's (HOU) hand while it is considered part of the ball.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) makes marginal contact with Harden (HOU) that does not affect his SQBR.
Tucker (HOU) firms up in a screening position in Gilgeous-Alexander's (LAC) path and does not deliver the contact.
Gallinari (LAC) is not in a legal guarding position and moves laterally into Harden's (HOU) path and the contact affects his SQBR.
Capela (HOU) does not establish a screening position in Bradley's (LAC) path, but any contact is marginal.
Harrell (LAC) makes contact with Harden's (HOU) head during his shooting motion on the jump shot attempt.
Anthony (HOU) engages with Harris (LAC) and briefly places two arms around him and immediately removes them. The contact does not affect his SQBR.
Anthony (HOU) makes contact with Williams' (LAC) right arm prior to his gather on the jump shot attempt.
Capela (HOU) and Harris (LAC) engage and disengage during rebounding.
Gallinari (LAC) makes contact with the ball and marginal contact with Harden (HOU) during his drive.
